c74object.name: evi_crossovers
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_crossovers.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_crossovers.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_crossovers.genexpr file also requires:
evi_approx.genexpr
About this File:
A collection of Linkwitz-Riley crossover filters in various configurations. These are TPT filters that sum perfectly flat on recombionation and can also be modulated at audio rate.

entry.name: eviXover2pole2band ( )
entry.description:
Two-pole two-band (low/high) crossover
In 1: type=input: X, Audio input to be split
In 2: type=input: xover, Crossover frequency in Hz
Return 1: Low, Low band audio output
Return 2: High, High band audio output
